_doc: Single config for one video. Paths are relative to this file. Fill in after the narration exists (times come from audio/words.json).
name: MEU PRODUTO - video viral 9x16

brand._doc: primary = highlight/gradient color, accent = secondary glow, alert = hook red, ok = check marks

timeline._doc: Section cut points in seconds (choose them in pauses between sentences). The starter scenes.js uses exactly these keys.

captions._doc: Karaoke captions only inside these windows (timeline keys or seconds). groups (optional) = words per caption chunk for each window; omit for automatic grouping.

base._doc: Edit map. Contiguous segments 0..duration. mode: 1x | mci (smooth slow-mo, slow render) | blend | image | black. Speed = sd/(t1-t0).

segments.note: replace with one segment per beat
end card background (overlay draws an opaque card)
